sources.title: Connectivity and Accessibility Statistics for Rural England - July 2026
May 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts

candidates.name: Rural-urban gigabit availability gap
candidates.gate: National residential context; exact address and UPRN join required.

candidates.name: Rural fixed/FWA decent-broadband residual
candidates.gate: England rural aggregate; not parcel-level availability.

candidates.name: Broadband USO residual
candidates.gate: Satellite affordability assumptions affect eligibility.

candidates.name: All-operator indoor 4G rural-urban gap
candidates.gate: Premises-level national context; no parcel promotion.

candidates.name: Rural indoor 4G not-spots
candidates.gate: Area statistic is not an address-level coverage assertion.

candidates.name: Standalone 5G rural-urban gap
candidates.gate: Outdoor premises context; no service-quality inference.

candidates.name: Project Gigabit rural upgrades
candidates.value: more than 1.3 million premises by end-December 2025
candidates.gate: Programme cumulative context, not current parcel service.

candidates.name: Government gigabit target
candidates.value: at least 99% of UK premises by 2032
candidates.gate: Policy target must not be treated as delivered coverage.

candidates.name: Shared Rural Network core objective
candidates.value: 95% geographic 4G from at least one operator
candidates.gate: Geographic area metric differs from premises coverage.

candidates.name: Shared Rural Network England mast count
candidates.gate: Mast count does not establish parcel availability.

candidates.name: Remaining SRN delivery window
candidates.gate: Planned work is not completed coverage.

candidates.name: ONS local gigabit indicator
candidates.gate: Use as local-area corroboration, not exact parcel truth.

candidates.name: ONS aggregation limitation
candidates.value: aggregated values may differ from other publications
candidates.gate: Cross-source differences require methodology reconciliation.

candidates.name: ONS uncertainty limitation
candidates.gate: Do not manufacture statistical uncertainty bounds.

candidates.name: BDUK supplier-resubmission correction
candidates.gate: Administrative revision must not be scored as delivery decline.

candidates.name: BDUK initial-scope limitation
candidates.gate: Contract totals are incomplete for full-scope inference.

candidates.name: BDUK comparability limitation
candidates.value: monthly management data not directly comparable with official statistics
candidates.gate: Keep management and official-statistics series separate.

candidates.name: BDUK ingestion-lag limitation
candidates.value: May snapshot should not assess milestones
candidates.gate: No contractual-performance inference.

candidates.name: BDUK rounding limitation
candidates.gate: Derived differences require rounding tolerance.

candidates.name: Exact UPRN promotion requirement
candidates.value: source package + content hash + exact UPRN join
candidates.gate: Canonical parcel promotion remains blocked.
